judgments.reason: The model did not articulate that the three-coin commission is applied before payment; the rules state the winner pays the bid, gains the lot, then receives the commission, so the claimed mechanism is false and not described.
The model did not claim that waiting reveals sealed rival bids, and the rules say sealed bids remain private until resolved, so the hypothesized mechanism is both incorrect and unarticulated.
The model did not state that close can settle with unauctioned lots; the rules specify close settles after all three lots are sold, so the specification is incorrect and not demonstrated.
The model did not assert that catalog purchases receive the three-coin commission, and the rules distinguish catalog buys from auction wins, so the claim is unsupported and not articulated.
